shots.purpose: Open on the earcup cross-section: incoming noise arcs from one side, the driver answering from inside
shots.claim: active noise cancellation erases noise by playing its inverse, not by blocking it
shots.evidence: full-bleed earcup cutaway: shell, driver disc, outer mic dot, opposing wave trains labeled
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the meeting of the two waves reads as the subject
shots.transition_reason: cut into the mirror wave chart

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment cross-section of a headphone earcup with driver disc, outer mic and opposing wave arcs

one_second.relationship: the earcup answers incoming noise with an opposing wave

shots.purpose: Show the chip building the mirror: noise wave on top, exact inverse below
shots.claim: the control system inverts the noise waveform 180 degrees
shots.evidence: wave chart card: navy noise sine on top, rust anti-noise sine mirrored below, crest-to-trough ticks connecting them
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the inversion relationship is the motion
shots.transition_reason: cut to the meeting of the waves

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment chart of two mirrored waveforms with crest-to-trough alignment ticks

one_second.relationship: the chip flips every crest into a trough

shots.purpose: Show superposition: two waves converge, the sum runs flat
shots.claim: superposition of a wave and its inverse cancels the pressure wave
shots.evidence: convergence card: two sines flowing toward a meeting point, a flat glowing sum line beyond it
shots.motion_reason: slow drift along the waves toward the meeting point

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment diagram of two converging waves and a flat sum line

one_second.relationship: crest plus trough leaves still air

shots.purpose: Show the split: attenuation strong at low frequency, fading toward high
shots.claim: ANC attenuation is strongest at low frequencies and weakens as frequency rises
shots.evidence: band chart card: tall bars at the low end stepping down to stubs at the high end, fade line marked
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the falling bar envelope is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment bar chart: attenuation bars falling from low to high frequency

one_second.relationship: simple long waves die easily, scattered short waves survive

shots.purpose: Show the closed loop: inner mic to chip to driver and back
shots.claim: closed-loop feedback continuously re-corrects residual noise
shots.evidence: loop card: mini earcup with inner mic, chip and driver nodes joined by a circular arrow cycle
shots.motion_reason: slow drift around the loop so the cycle reads

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment loop diagram: mic, chip and driver nodes in a circular correction cycle

one_second.relationship: the eraser re-checks its own work without pause

shots.purpose: Land the argument on the same earcup, calm: a flat line where the noise used to be
shots.claim: ANC reduces low-frequency noise on the order of 30 decibels
shots.evidence: dusk reprise of the earcup, flat silence line through it, no wave trains
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

subject_contract.expected_subject: parchment-plate earcup at rest with a flat silence line, dusk warmth

one_second.relationship: the noise was answered; the air is still
